sources.title: Natural Earth Nile axes, canal axes and explicit salt pan references

access_metadata.source_date: 2022 release; observations composite, not a dated survey
access_metadata.geometry: Source River and Lake Centerline; Lake and Alkaline Lake polygons. Reservoir polygons excluded.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern generalised reference. River axes through regulated reaches are not reconstructed 1900 channels. Natural lake levels, deltas and banks may differ.
access_metadata.categories: River/lake-centreline axes; explicit Playa=salt pan/intermittent lake, not permanent water. Desert label polygons are not used as land cover.
access_metadata.historical_canals: Suez existed1869; modern generalized single axis is not a1900 bank or width survey.

sources.title: HydroRIVERS v1 Europe/Middle East and Africa clipped routed network
sources.publisher: WWF / HydroSHEDS; Bernhard Lehner and Günther Grill

access_metadata.sampling: Network extracted from15arcsec HydroSHEDS; coarser Hydro1k north of60N. No true river width.
access_metadata.source_epoch: SRTM mainly2000 plus composite ancillary/higher-latitude data; v1 modern reference, not1900
access_metadata.attribution: HydroRIVERS © WWF; Lehner B., Grill G.(2013), Global river hydrography and network routing, Hydrological Processes27:2171–2186; https://doi.org/10.1002/hyp.9740
